name: Umami Finance
rootCause: Umami Finance, a DeFi protocol on Arbitrum, offers yield products to institutional clients. On January 31, they announced they were suspending yields, saying they were concerned about regulatory tactics. Soon after, the project CEO started dumping tokens on the market, cashing out 44,000 UMAMI tokens. These were ostensibly priced at $800,000, and although the sell-off sent UMAMI prices crashing by more than 60%, the CEO still netted around $380,000 in USDC.
